jobs.description: AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to embed with FDE delivery teams and own the security posture of production AI systems deployed in customer environments. You conduct security reviews, perform threat modeling, build security automation, and ensure every FDE-delivered system meets both AWS and customer security standards. You move at the speed of the FDE team: weeks, not quarters. You don't just flag risks and hand them back. You find the vulnerability, design the fix, and ship the control. This role combines the depth of a senior application security engineer with the urgency and customer-facing presence of forward-deployed engineering. You secure AI/ML pipelines end-to-end, build reusable security tooling that scales the FDE practice, and operate with a production mindset from day one of deployment. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen. Key job responsibilities - Conduct security design reviews, threat modeling, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations, customer data pipelines) - Embed with FDE delivery teams in customer environments; assess infrastructure security posture, identify gaps, implement controls while maintaining delivery velocity - Build security automation and tooling: scanning, testing, monitoring capabilities purpose-built for forward-deployed AI systems; create reusable security accelerators - Implement controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection, guardrail bypass, model endpoint hardening, training data protection, output filtering, data isolation - Integrate security into FDE engineering workflows: CI/CD security gates, secrets management, dependency scanning, container security - Triage and respond to security incidents in production AI systems; build monitoring and alerting for AI-specific security signals - Document solutions as reusable patterns, playbooks, and architectural guidance - Requires up to 25% travel 10047 A day in the life You start the day reviewing a pull request from an FDE engineer building a multi-agent orchestration system for a healthcare customer, catching an authorization gap before it ships. Mid-morning you're on-site with the customer's security team walking through your threat model for their RAG pipeline. After lunch you're writing a reusable Terraform module that enforces data isolation for multi-tenant AI deployments. You close out the day running automated guardrail tests against a Bedrock-powered application before it goes live. Every week brings a different customer, a different architecture, and a new AI security challenge. About the team AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven. 회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Automation Process Excellence(APE) 팀은 FC(Fulfillment Center) 네트워크 전반에 걸쳐 자동화 기술 및 프로세스의 도입과 최적화를 주도하는 팀입니다. Operations 및 다양한 유관 부서와 긴밀히 협업하며 운영 표준을 수립하고, 신규 기술 도입을 지원하며, 프로세스 효율성 향상과 비용 절감 활동을 추진하는 동시에 최고의 고객 경험을 제공하는 데 기여합니다.
업무 내용
AGV/ACR 및 FC 운영 성과 지표 모니터링 및 분석, 근본 원인 분석(Root Cause Analysis)을 통한 개선 기회 발굴
생산성, 처리 용량(Capacity), 처리량(Throughput), 인력 효율성 및 운영 비용 개선을 위한 프로세스 최적화 추진
지속 가능한 개선 조치(Corrective Action) 및 모범 사례(Best Practice) 개발, 실행 및 표준화

jobs.description: Craft: Data, Analytics & Strategy Job Description: Your Role Within Our Kingdom We are looking for a dedicated and creative Sr. Data Scientist to join the Product Development and Experimentation teams in Catalog Games! You will help shape the future of our games through deep data insights that unlock player behaviors and business opportunities. As part of a diverse and talented analytics community, you’ll support multiple teams in creating entertaining, data-driven experiences for millions of players. Working closely with game designers, game leads, developers, and other data scientists, you will define experiments, drive actionable insights, help identify strategic opportunities, and continuously evolve how we understand and enhance our games. Key Responsibilities: Design, analyze, and present results from A/B tests to inform feature and game development. Be the end-to-end owner of the experimental aspects in initiatives. Proactively conduct rigorous data explorations and develop models that uncover new opportunities. Deliver clear and impactful visualizations and presentations tailored to diverse audiences. Ensure data quality and accessibility to support informed decision-making across teams. Support the evolution of Catalog Games’ data science methodologies and tooling, and act as a craft role model. Collaborate across games to share insights, tools, and learnings that benefit the broader portfolio. Systematically break down abstract problems into concrete analytical questions. Skills to Create Thrills Analytical & Technical: Strong background in applied statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling. Advanced proficiency in SQL for working with large-scale, complex datasets (300M+ players). Skilled in Python or R for statistical analysis, modeling and automations. Deep understanding of statistical methodologies, including A/B testing and experimental design. Experience with big data platforms (e.g., GCP/BigQuery, AWS…). Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau). Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git), and experience in collaborative programming. Business & Communication: Strong business insight: able to frame product questions into structured analyses. Effective communicator: present data stories clearly and influence diverse stakeholders. Collaborative and strategic mindset: ability to work cross-functionally and guide decision-making. Tasty Bonus Skills Experience with mobile game analytics or in-game advertising. Familiarity and interest in agentic workflows (Codex, Claude…) Contributions to data science communities or internal capability-building initiatives. A Great Saga Needs All Sorts of Heroes Making games is fun—especially with people who share the same passion. At King, we embrace diversity and believe it leads to more creative solutions and richer game experiences. If you're excited about data, games, and working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and join us in Making the World Playful. Applications need to be in English. About King With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

jobs.description: Love the idea of stopping security problems before they ever reach production — at a scale most engineers never get to touch?
